title: 门运动磁拨动压电无线事件节点 · 数字工程样机
scope: Reference-assisted digital design; no hardware calibration or radio reception claim.

pzt.material: COMSOL PZT-5A library, assumed grade; perfect bond; +z polarization

magnets.source: custom NdFeB N42 nominal; Br, coercivity and tolerances require supplier qualification

acceptance.stress_limit_status: not qualified: report stress; no fatigue certification

assumptions: Door dimensions and installation are explicit design assumptions, not measured premises.
PZT grade, bonding, damping and magnet remanence are nominal; uncertainty must remain visible.
No neural network is needed for a binary motion-event transmitter; no artificial NAS claim.
Animation door rotation is prescribed; beam animation must be labelled by its actual solved or imposed origin.
revision_reason: D1 dx=26 mm produces approx 4 N transverse magnetic force; beyond 8 mm linear-ROM validity. D2 increases magnetic center x separation to 48 mm; acceptance limits retained.
